question: Do matched WebArena-Verified families at 0%,25%,50%,75%,100% novelty (train on resource A, test on never-observed B with 36 families >=3, duplication 0.9479) show later-agent cost tracking residual novelty rather than full length when SPIDER parameterized inheritance is implemented as a real resolve/bind pipeline (required_slots, freshness gating 0.25, confidence<0.80 UNKNOWN abstention, verification/repair) measured as tokens+browser+retrieval+verification+repair amortized over frequency vs COLD vs instructions vs retrievable RAG vs TERX 0-token replay that hits at 0% with block-permutation p-values?
hypothesis: Later-agent cost under SPIDER parameterized inheritance (freshness gating + UNKNOWN abstention) tracks residual novelty fraction, not full task length, with genuine measured cost (not defined from novelty): cost_SPIDER(n) = C_fixed (retrieval+verification) + C_novel * novelty_fraction where n in {0.0,0.25,0.50,0.75,1.0} is fraction of parameterizable identifier slots whose values were never observed during training on resource A (test on unseen B), C_fixed is low constant (retrieval 200 tok+150ms + verification 50 tok+120ms), and C_novel << C_cold_full (500 tok+2 browser calls per novel step). At n=0.0 (exact repeat of training trajectory, same identifier sequence) SPIDER cost is >=60% cheaper than B-COLD (full-length) and within 2x of B-REPLAY-TERX (0-token replay cost ~50 tokens verification only) with high reuse fraction >=0.90 and low false_accept <=0.10. At n=1.0 (all identifiers unseen, never-observed B) SPIDER cost via UNKNOWN fallback approx = COLD cost (<=10% higher). Spearman rho(cost_SPIDER, novelty_fraction) >=0.60 (two-sided block-permutation p<0.01, bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.35, slope >0 p<0.01) and novelty-fraction model R2 exceeds full-task-length model R2 by >=0.15 (R2_novelty >=0.30 given R2_length approx 0.00 due to constant L=10). SPIDER amortized cost per success beats B-COLD, B-RAG and B-INSTRUCTIONS at low novelty (0%,25%) at f=10 and beats B-REPLAY-TERX at any novelty >=25% where exact replay misses, demonstrating pay-cost-of-novelty work compression with honest accounting (distill applied only to SPIDER).
falsifier: FALSIFIED if ANY of: (F1) SPIDER success <0.85 at 0% novelty or mean success across bins <0.80 or false_accept >0.10 or binding error rate >0.20 (parameterized inheritance does not work or contaminates via false accepts, with genuine verification-derived success not hash-assigned); (F2) SPIDER amortized cost at 0% not meaningfully cheaper than B-COLD (ratio SPIDER/COLD >0.65 at f=1 raw+amortized consistent units) or SPIDER 0% cost >2.0x B-REPLAY-TERX at 0% (no advantage over strong replay baseline for exact repeats where B-REPLAY-TERX must hit at 1.0 inside compared set); (F3) No novelty tracking: Spearman rho(cost_SPIDER, novelty) <0.35 or two-sided block-permutation p>=0.01 (exact p=2/120=0.0167 for perfect monotone of 5 bins fails threshold, acknowledging tie structure) or slope <=0; (F4) Novelty does not explain cost better than full length: R2_novelty - R2_length <0.05 (with length constant L=10, failure means cost flat or driven by other factors) or R2_novelty <0.30; (F5) SPIDER not beating B-RAG retrieval baseline at low novelty (SPIDER amortized cost >=0.80x B-RAG cost at 0% and 25% at f=10 with retrieval-derived success) or not beating B-INSTRUCTIONS by 15% (ratio >0.85) or not beating B-REPLAY-TERX at any novelty >=25% (cost_SPIDER >= cost_REPLAY at 0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00 at f=10); (F6) Positive controls fail (exact-repeat literal replay not 0 LLM tokens +1 browser verification call, or training-resource-A tested on same A not EXECUTABLE with reused>=0.90) or null controls show spurious novelty tracking (NC1 shuffled |rho|>=0.25 p<0.05 or NC2 random false_accept <0.30 with flat-cost guarantee broken). MIXED if C1 passes but F3/F4 fail: mechanisms work but cost is flat (constant overhead, no proportionality), indicating reuse without compression. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if harness cannot bind parameters via actual registry/required_slots, verification/repair simulation broken, or all systems <0.50 success even at 0% (substrate failure, not scientific falsification), or block-permutation null variance degenerate with no behavioral variability to permit inference.

baselines.description: Cold start with no SPIDER memory: simulated LLM explores task from scratch each time. Cost = full task length x simulated LLM cost (500 tokens/step + 2 browser calls/step + 120ms latency). No retrieval, no verification, no reuse. Upper-bound full-length cost. Success measured via verification postconditions on simulated browser state, not assigned constant, but expected lower than SPIDER with inheritance. Distill cost NOT added (honest accounting: distill only for SPIDER).
baselines.expected: Cost independent of novelty fraction (flat line ~ task_length x unit_cost). Success lower than SPIDER. Used as denominator for work-compression ratio at consistent amortization f.

baselines.description: Site-specific hand-authored instructions baseline (strong instruction prompt, no retrieval). Simulates providing agent with natural-language site instructions (e.g., catalog search procedure) but no parameterized mechanism. Cost = instruction tokens amortized over f (200/f) + full exploration of identifier-specific steps: 9x500 tok (one reasoning step saved) + 18 browser calls. Tests whether instructions alone achieve novelty-proportional cost without SPIDER. Distill NOT added; instruction tokens correctly amortized.
baselines.expected: Cost slightly below B-COLD but still ~ full length; not novelty-proportional beyond instruction token savings. Expected beaten by SPIDER at low novelty by >=15% amortized at f=10.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval / RAG over prior trajectories: nearest successful trajectory retrieved by Jaccard over intent+keywords (TAU=0.30, same as pre-2.0 Graph). Replay verbatim without parameter induction, but now RETRIEVABLE: sampling ensures at n=0.0 test identifier sequence exactly equals a training trajectory (Jaccard 1.0 -> hit), at intermediate bins overlap proportional to novelty (e.g., n=0.25 -> ~0.75 overlap). If retrieved trajectory identifiers match test identifiers at verification (actual resolve/bind check), reuse at 0 cost for matching steps; otherwise replay fails verification and falls back to B-COLD LLM exploration for mismatched steps. Retrieval cost 200 tok +150ms per task. Success derived from verification outcomes after fallback, not hash bands; hits/misses measured directly.
baselines.expected: At 0% novelty similar to SPIDER (both hit); at >=25% worse than SPIDER because without parameterization every novel identifier triggers fallback. SPIDER expected to beat B-RAG by >=20% at 0% and 25% amortized at f=10.

baselines.description: TERX / BrowserBash 0-token exact replay with LLM fallback: if test task's full identifier sequence exactly equals a training trajectory (exact string equality on action_template, no parameterization), replay at 0 LLM tokens + 1 verification browser call (~90ms, 50 tokens verification only) +1 browser call; otherwise replay fails and falls back to B-COLD LLM exploration for full task. Strongest exact-repeat economics baseline. RESOLVES prior frozen contradiction by choosing exact-repeat semantics for n=0.0 inside compared set: n=0.0 tasks ARE exact repeats, so hit_rate=1.0 at 0% novelty is reachable and measured (not only hand-injected PC1). Hit cost = 50 tok verification only; miss cost = 5500 tok (5000+500 verification).
baselines.expected: Amortized cost = (hit_rate x 50 tok + miss_rate x COLD_cost) + amortized distill NOT added. At 0% novelty hit_rate=1.0 -> cost ~50 tok << SPIDER (SPIDER allowed up to 2x REPLAY at 0%). At 100% novelty hit_rate=0.0 -> cost = COLD. SPIDER expected cheaper than REPLAY at 25%,50%,75%,100% where replay misses.

baselines.description: Fail-able length-proportional control: cost = task length x unit cost regardless of novelty (flat vs novelty) but with varying length simulation to ensure null can fail C3/C4. Added per RF9 to make MIXED and falsifier reachable: this system should NOT show novelty tracking (rho approx 0) and should fail C3/C4 by construction, demonstrating the environment can express flat-cost and falsified outcomes, not only supports.
baselines.expected: Spearman |rho|<0.25, R2_novelty approx 0, fails C3/C4, demonstrating falsifier is reachable.

positive_control.description: Two positive controls exercising real pipeline: (PC1) Exact-repeat literal mechanism: training resource A mechanism replayed on same resource A with 0% novelty (exact identifier sequence) must achieve 100% success via B-REPLAY-TERX pipeline with 0 LLM tokens +1 browser verification call (50 tok) and measured hit_rate=1.0 inside main set (not only hand-injected row). Validates substrate can measure 0-cost case. (PC2) Parameterized inheritance on seen identifiers: SPIDER distill_parameterized trained on 5 observations of resource A (e.g., SKUs A1..A5, stores A) tested on same set A via actual registry/required_slots/bind/verify pipeline (not forced constant) must resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action binding and 100% success with reused_actions >=0.90 and false_accept 0.0, confirming parameter induction works before testing generalization to B. Both controls use measured verification outcomes, not forced constants.
positive_control.expected_behavior: PC1: B-REPLAY-TERX at 0% cost = 50 tokens (0 LLM +50 verification), 1 browser call, 100% success, hit_rate 1.0. PC2: SPIDER at 0% success >=0.95, reused_actions >=0.90, false_accept 0.0, UNKNOWN 0.0. Failure of either due to harness binding errors -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

null_control.description: Two null controls exercising real semantics (not flat-cost guarantees): (NC1) Shuffled parameter-slot mapping: randomly permute the learned parameter slot -> identifier binding (e.g., swap ${sku} with ${store_id}) before SPIDER resolve on same 100 tasks via actual registry/bind/verify pipeline; each task still incurs real retrieval+verify+fallback costs based on verification outcomes (mismatched binds fail verification and trigger repair/fallback cost, introducing variability). Expected: Spearman |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 via block-permutation and success <= B-COLD, false_accept elevated, proving observed novelty tracking requires correct parameterization not any reuse. (NC2) Random mechanism selection: SPIDER retrieval returns random registry entry instead of ranked match, UNKNOWN disabled, via actual ranking path; expected cost flat vs novelty, no R2 advantage, false_accept >=0.30 or |rho|<0.25, demonstrating ranking/gating matters. Both controls go through actual binding/verification so they CAN fail the expected null pattern if mapping truly matters (i.e., they are not guaranteed flat).
null_control.expected_behavior: NC1 |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 (block-permutation) and success <= B-COLD; NC2 false_accept >=0.30 (verification-derived) or |rho|<0.25. If NC1 shows |rho|>=0.35 p<0.05, observed effect is spurious (task difficulty confounded) -> measurement invalid for novelty claim.

measurement_validity: 1. No real LLM API calls: all LLM cost is via deterministic measured execution of actual pipeline branches (not formula from novelty). Each task cost = sum of executed branches: retrieval (200 tok+150ms) + verification (50 tok+120ms if EXECUTABLE attempted) + execution (0 tok for verified reused steps, 500 tok+2 browser calls per novel/failed-verification step) + repair (500 tok+2 calls if verification fails). Cost is independent of novelty label; novelty influences cost only via pipeline decisions (binding success/failure, freshness/UNKNOWN). Proxy values frozen before execution; sensitivity analysis varies tokens/step +/-50% and browser latency +/-50% in report. This implements RF1+RF2: mechanism executed, dependent variable not bijective formula.

2. Matched task families with constant full length L=10 (search->filter->open->select->add->checkout->verify) so full_task_length constant across novelty bins; only residual_novelty_fraction varies (0%,25%,50%,75%,100% of parameterizable identifier slots are unseen B values, others are seen A values) with n=0.0 defined as exact repeat (test sequence == training trajectory) to make B-REPLAY-TERX hit_rate=1.0 reachable inside compared set (resolves prior contradiction prereg 4.1 vs spec B-REPLAY expectation, RF3). 20 tasks per bin =100 SPIDER test tasks (+ same 100 for each baseline =500 trials + controls). Training uses disjoint resource A SKU set (A_SKU_001..050, A_STORE_01..06); testing on resource B SKU set (B_SKU_001..050, B_STORE_07..12) with zero overlap except as controlled by novelty fraction; Jaccard sampling ensures RAG retrievability at low novelty (RF4).

3. WebArena-Verified family source: attempt to load WebArena-Verified shopping task definitions and accessibility-tree fragments from repo cache or /tmp/webarena if present (36 families >=3, duplication 0.9479 per portfolio assessment); if inaccessible, use synthetic Flask catalog mock replicating WebArena structure (12 store instances sharing platform per EXP-INTEL-35651934683 M1=0.311 corrected, 996-task structure, template parameterization) as isomorphic proxy. Chosen source logged in provenance.json and disclosed as validity caveat; claim ceiling bounded to synthetic/WebArena-inspired mock without Docker/full-DOM complexity (single-family bounded evidence; two-family replication is follow-up). This preserves Director dependencies (intel sample-level overlap, graph reuse, runtime isolation) as prerequisites for scale-up, not gating for proxy isolation.

4. SPIDER mechanism implementation: harness-level distill_parameterized with _extract_varying_values (field-path-relevant, structure-similarity >=0.75, validated in EXP-PRODUCT-33741671686 but still harness-only per kernel literal-only audit) applied to 5 training observations per family to induce parameter_slots (${sku}, ${store_id}, possibly ${variant}) via actual code path; registry stores one parameterized mechanism per family at confidence 0.90 via actual registry write/read. At resolve time, require exact required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | template_slots present in params, freshness gating via behavioral_score threshold 0.25 (JWT mock probe as in parent, exercised as gating signal), and UNKNOWN abstention if confidence<0.80 or freshness stale or required_slots missing. If UNKNOWN -> fallback cost = B-COLD simulated LLM cost for remaining steps (honest abstention, counted in cost/repair). If EXECUTABLE -> bound_action = _bind(action_template, params) via actual _bind and verification checks postconditions; on verification failure charge repair cost (1 LLM step) and count false_accept if binding wrong. No forced constants; success/false_accept/unknown rates are verification-derived with genuine variability (RF1,RF7).

5. End-to-end cost accounting with honest amortization: per-task cost = retrieval_cost + verification_cost + execution_cost + repair_cost as measured. Amortized cost per success = (total_cost + distill_cost/f)/success_rate where distill_cost (1000 tok) is added ONLY to SPIDER (not to B-COLD/B-RAG/B-REPLAY/B-INSTRUCTIONS), and B-INSTRUCTIONS instruction tokens (200) are correctly amortized as 200/f (honest f=10 is 20+4500=4520, not 4800). Raw-token and amortized ratios reported separately with matching bootstrap CIs on same units (RF6 fix). Report at f=1,10,100 to compare vs TERX 0-token replay.

6. Strong baseline execution: all baselines run on identical 100-task novelty-matched set with identical proxy and same fallback/verification logic, using same pipeline harness. B-RAG retrieval uses Jaccard TAU=0.30 and success follows verification (retrievable at 0% by construction). B-REPLAY-TERX uses exact action_template string equality (no parameterization) to decide hit/miss inside main set, then LLM fallback; hit_rate measured in main set. B-LENGTH-PROPORTIONAL added as fail-able control to demonstrate environment can express flat-cost/MIXED outcomes (RF9).

7. Statistics honoring 5-bin structure: primary novelty-tracking test is Spearman rho between per-task SPIDER token cost (n=100, 20 per bin) and novelty_fraction. Use exact block-permutation p-value (permutation over 5 bin labels respecting within-bin exchangeability; perfect monotone pattern p=2/5!=0.0167 two-sided, one-sided 1/120=0.0083) as primary, not normal approximation on ties; report normal approximation as secondary. Power >0.90 to detect rho>=0.60 at alpha=0.01 requires n>=44; introduce sampling variability via actual pipeline decisions so data not 20-fold ties of 5 values. Linear regression cost~novelty reports slope, p, R2_novelty vs R2_length. Bootstrap 5000 resamples stratified by bin for CI on cost ratios and rho with degenerate handling (if variance 0, CI reported as [value,value] with flag). Two-sided tests; bootstrap CIs on same units as decision metric.

8. Human-readable prereg frozen before any outcome-bearing measurement; code, fixtures, proxy constants, and decision thresholds hashed in freeze.json. Execution uses deterministic seeds (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, explicit random.seed 42) and logs all hashes.
decision_rule: SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires ALL of (C1)-(C6) measured via actual pipeline (not formula): (C1) SPIDER M-SUCCESS-SPIDER at n=0.0 >=0.85 (Wilson 95% CI lower >=0.72) and mean success across n in {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0} >=0.80, with M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER <=0.10 and binding error rate <=0.20 (all via verification-derived outcomes, not constants) and M-UNKNOWN-RATE-SPIDER =0.0 at 0% and >0.0 allowed at 100% via genuine UNKNOWN branch; (C2) Work compression at low novelty: M-COST-RATIO-SPIDER-COLD-0pct at f=1 (amortized with honest distill-only-SPIDER) <=0.35 (>=65% cheaper than COLD) and M-COST-RATIO-SPIDER-REPLAY-0pct at f=1 <=2.0 (SPIDER within 2x of 0-token replay hit 50 tok) and at n=1.0 SPIDER/COLD <=1.10 via UNKNOWN fallback (all using consistent amortized units with matching bootstrap CIs); (C3) Novelty tracking: M-SPEARMAN-RHO >=0.60 with two-sided block-permutation p<0.01 (exact 2/120 threshold) and bootstrap 95% CI lower >0.35 and M-SLOPE-NOVELTY >0 p<0.01; (C4) Residual-novelty explanatory power: M-R2-DELTA = R2_novelty - R2_length >=0.15 and M-R2-NOVELTY >=0.30 given M-R2-LENGTH approx 0.00 (L=10 constant; report CI upper <0.15 for length); (C5) Beating strong memory baselines at f=10 honest amortization: SPIDER beats B-RAG (cost_SPIDER/cost_RAG <=0.80 at n=0.0 and 0.25 with retrieval-derived success) and beats B-INSTRUCTIONS (<=0.85 same bins) and beats B-REPLAY-TERX at every n>=0.25 (cost_SPIDER < cost_REPLAY at 0.25,0.50,0.75,1.00); (C6) Controls: PC1 B-REPLAY-TERX at 0% measured cost =50 tok and hit_rate=1.0 in main set and PC2 M-REUSED-ACTIONS-FRACTION-SPIDER at 0% >=0.90 via measured pipeline pass; NC1 M-CORRELATION-NC-SHUFFLE |rho|<0.25 p>=0.05 (block-permutation) and success <= B-COLD; NC2 random-retrieval false_accept >=0.30 or |rho|<0.25 (verification-derived). FALSIFIED if any C1-C6 fails (excluding PC/NC substrate failures which are MEASUREMENT_INVALID). MIXED if C1 passes but C3 or C4 fails: mechanisms succeed but cost flat vs novelty (constant overhead dominates), indicating reuse without residual-novelty proportionality, demonstrated reachable via B-LENGTH-PROPORTIONAL control. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC1/PC2 fail due to harness binding/execution errors (success <0.50 at 0% for all systems or binding error >0.20) or NC1 spuriously shows |rho|>=0.35 p<0.05 indicating novelty label confounded or infrastructure failure (registry write/read, mock unreachable). All recomputations use frozen metric IDs and raw CSV; block-permutation p is primary.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY advances HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL at bounded synthetic/WebArena-inspired mock ceiling (L=10 fixed, token/browser proxy, localhost harness, n=100, single-family, harness-level distill). Establishes first direct measurement that later-agent cost tracks residual novelty not full length with genuine pipeline variability, with quantified compression (>=65% cheaper than COLD at 0%, novelty R2 advantage >=0.15, beats retrievable RAG and 0-token REPLAY at >0% at honest amortization and with reachable falsifiers). Unblocks C-PRODUCT-ECON: provides residual-novelty effect size to justify amortized-economics scale-up with real LLM measurement and Docker full-DOM hosting (Intel sample-level overlap + Runtime distributed replication become next prerequisites per Director dependencies). Informs commercial viability vs TERX 90ms exact-repeat dominance. No immediate PRODUCT_CORE promotion; requires replication with real LLM tokens and production WebArena hosting.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED: C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS (or bounded REJECTED for proxy setting: cost flat or not cheaper than strong baselines with honest accounting). If MIXED (C1 passes but C3/C4 fail), product must investigate constant overhead (retrieval/verification/repair dominated) rather than residual-novelty scaling, preventing premature amortization claim. If SPIDER not beating B-RAG/B-REPLAY-TERX (where B-REPLAY-TERX now hits at 0% inside set), parameterized inheritance adds no economics beyond retrievable retrieval or exact replay, supporting caching-vs-generalization tension that exact replay dominates at current scale; Product lane should redirect to higher-leverage claims C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR substrate (runtime nginx HIT/SWR/SIE) or C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, and defer C-PRODUCT-ECON scale-up. If MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to harness/binding failures, priority is fixing distill_parameterized kernel integration and RF1-RF9 substrate before re-testing economics.
estimated_cost: Zero LLM API calls (token/browser proxy via measured pipeline branches). Synthetic catalog mock or cached WebArena JSON fixtures (no Docker, no external APIs, no browser automation). ~900 lines Python (harness + mock catalog if needed + actual kernel resolve/bind/verify wiring). 5 binsx20 tasksx5 systems (COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RAG/REPLAY/SPIDER+LENGTH control) +2 controlsx100 + PCs = ~800 trials. Each trial simulated via pipeline (no real browser): ~5ms per trial. Total wall-clock <15 minutes on GitHub Actions runner. Storage: per-task CSV ~800 rows + registry JSON + cost_config. Deterministic (PYTHONHASHSEED=0, random.seed 42).
expected_information_gain: HIGH: First valid measurement of SPIDER's central economic hypothesis after one inflated doc survey (M1 0.818->0.311, no cost measurement) and one MEASUREMENT_INVALID (bijective cost formula, starved baselines, degenerate p). Either a positive (novelty-proportional compression beating retrievable RAG and 0-token REPLAY at >0% with honest accounting and block-permutation p<0.01) or a valid negative (flat cost, or no advantage over retrievable RAG/REPLAY where baselines actually hit) decisively changes product decision: (1) whether C-PRODUCT-ECON amortized scale-up to real LLM/Docker is justified vs premature, (2) whether parameterized inheritance justifies productization despite TERX 90ms dominance, (3) whether caching-vs-generalization favors SPIDER at low-to-moderate novelty and informs amortized repair cost. Opens path to delta-repair localized cost test (runtime nginx substrate) per Director comparative reasoning. Resolves opportunity cost of tunneled freshness/PMI loops.
